description: This file contains the transformation logic for the Gemini realtime API, including classes and methods for handling real-time event transformation, session management, and event mapping specific to Gemini API responses within a larger language model infrastructure.

classes.name: GeminiRealtimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for handling Gemini realtime API transformations, including environment validation, URL generation, event mapping, and session management.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Validates the environment headers for Gemini API calls, returns headers.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Constructs the WebSocket URL for Gemini API based on base URL, model, and API key.

methods.name: OpenAIRealtimeEventTypes map_model_turn_event( self, model_turn: HttpxContentType )
methods.description: Maps a model turn event to an OpenAIRealtimeEventTypes enum based on content parts.

methods.name: OpenAIRealtimeEventTypes map_generation_complete_event( self, delta_type: Optional[ALL_DELTA_TYPES] )
methods.description: Maps delta type ('text' or 'audio') to corresponding OpenAIRealtimeEventTypes.

methods.name: get_audio_mime_type(self, input_audio_format: str = "pcm16")
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given audio format.

methods.name: AutomaticActivityDetection map_automatic_turn_detection( self, value: OpenAIRealtimeTurnDetection )
methods.description: Maps OpenAIRealtimeTurnDetection parameters to AutomaticActivityDetection configuration.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI parameters for Gemini models.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, optional_params: dict, non_default_params: dict )
methods.description: Maps optional parameters into the request configuration, handling special cases like instructions, temperature, tools, etc.

methods.name: List[str] transform_realtime_request( self, message: str, model: str, session_configuration_request: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms a message into WebSocket requests, including session setup and input audio/text.

methods.name: OpenAIRealtimeStreamSessionEvents transform_session_created_event( self, model: str, logging_session_id: str, session_configuration_request: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Generates a session creation event with model, instructions, and response modalities.

methods.name: bool _is_new_content_delta( self, previous_messages: Optional[List[OpenAIRealtimeEvents]] = None, )
methods.description: Determines if the current delta is new based on previous messages.

methods.name: List[OpenAIRealtimeEvents] return_new_content_delta_events( self, response_id: str, output_item_id: str, conversation_id: str, delta_type: ALL_DELTA_TYPES, session_configuration_request: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates initial response events for new content delta.

methods.name: OpenAIRealtimeResponseDelta transform_content_delta_events( self, message: BidiGenerateContentServerContent, output_item_id: str, response_id: str, delta_type: ALL_DELTA_TYPES, )
methods.description: Transforms server content into delta responses for text or audio.

methods.name: Union[OpenAIRealtimeResponseTextDone,OpenAIRealtimeResponseAudioDone] transform_content_done_event( self, delta_chunks: Optional[List[OpenAIRealtimeResponseDelta]], current_output_item_id: Optional[str], current_response_id: Optional[str], delta_type: ALL_DELTA_TYPES, )
methods.description: Creates 'done' events for response text or audio.

methods.name: List[OpenAIRealtimeEvents] return_additional_content_done_events( self, current_output_item_id: Optional[str], current_response_id: Optional[str], delta_done_event: Union[ OpenAIRealtimeResponseTextDone, OpenAIRealtimeResponseAudioDone ], delta_type: ALL_DELTA_TYPES, )
methods.description: Returns 'done' events for content parts and output items.

methods.name: OpenAIRealtimeEventTypes map_openai_event( self, key: str, value: dict, current_delta_type: Optional[ALL_DELTA_TYPES], json_message: dict, )
methods.description: Maps incoming message keys and values to internal OpenAIRealtimeEventTypes.

methods.name: RealtimeResponseTypedDict transform_realtime_response( self, message: Union[str, bytes], model: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, realtime_response_transform_input: RealtimeResponseTransformInput, )
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON messages into internal response events, managing state like current item and response IDs.

methods.name: bool requires_session_configuration(self)
methods.description: Indicates that session configuration is required.

methods.name: str session_configuration_request(self, model: str)
methods.description: Generates a session setup configuration for Gemini API.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
